decisions: Owner answers 2026-09-19: scope is g2, g4, g5 only; hold g3 (D-12 unanswered); 003 partial first, then 004; enable storage-api; generated placeholder PDF; the bucket and policy live in a new migration 0005_storage_artifacts.sql, not in seed.sql.
0004_lite.sql and 02 §8.1 are untouched (still byte-identical); the new migration is additive.
The PDF upload runs signed in as the seeded leader, so the storage policy (leader-write) authorises it and no secret key is used (RULE-01).

artifacts.storage_path holds the DB-Q11 string 'artifacts/{sessionId}/{artifactId}.pdf'; the bucket is its first segment and the object name inside the bucket is '{sessionId}/{artifactId}.pdf', which is why the policy reads the first path segment.
artifact_object_session() is plpgsql and returns null for a non-uuid segment, so a bad path is denied instead of raising a cast error.

db:seed is hosted in database-thinkboard-lite/package.json (an analyze decision the plan left open): supabase db reset applies migrations + seed.sql, then the node step uploads. Local login: leader@, member-a@, member-b@thinkboard.test, password 'password' (dev-only, defaulted).
The seed-twice test lives in its own folder (tests/seed/) and script (test:seed) because it resets the database and would break rls.test.mjs if run in parallel.
imgproxy stays excluded; storage-api booted without it.
